title: CPU Loop Fix (Library of Ruina)
description: Fixes a pointless loop in the Unity binding that copies native GetComponents results into a managed List: after the results are copied, the loop walked every unused slot up to the list's capacity and discarded the result, wasting CPU on every call. Measured at about 10% of main-thread samples, and 26% of main-thread samples in late frames, in a Library of Ruina 1.0.3 capture. For Library of Ruina 1.0.3.

launcher.label: CPU Loop Fix
launcher.note: Fixes a pointless loop in the game's code that wasted CPU time every time the UI rebuilt itself. Frees up processing power for smoother performance.
